abstract: Nutsafir Cookies is a processed food MSME from Lombok that has been operating since 2012 and has successfully expanded into export markets through the Shopee Export Program and Shopee FLEXI. Amid sales growth reaching hundreds of percent annually through digital channels, the owner faces increasingly intense competition from similar souvenir MSMEs in Lombok.
